limits: Bg/Fg use the established original Spine pose sampled at idle_loop time zero; full animated background Spine and optional window-resize zoom are outside this stage.
Particle initialization uses stable cosmetic index/cycle samples and phases, not the original GPU random stream.

Fog uses bounded fixed-point continuous integration of the original curve and 64 direction samples for its approximately 1.11-screen-pixel emitter radius. Discrete GPU integration/CurveTexture interpolation need not match frame by frame.
Nearest texture scaling, one/two-pixel stars and RGB565 are calculator adaptations; this is not an original-PC framebuffer or full GPU reproduction claim.
No physical-calculator FPS, overall UI-completeness percentage or final ARM acceptance is established by these native receipts.
Do not infer that the added layers are free: native title CPU and decoded-cache working-set increases are explicitly recorded.
